I'm so sorry to hear that there's been an issue with the system. To be honest, I'm a bit anxious about being here today, but I'm trying to be brave because I know I need help. I've been feeling really overwhelmed since having my baby. I'm tired all the time, and it's hard for me to enjoy the things I used to love. Even simple tasks feel like a huge burden. I just feel so guilty and inadequate as a mother, like I'm not doing enough for my baby. Sometimes I get these worries that something bad might happen to my baby, and it's hard for me to calm down. I've been crying a lot lately, and it feels like I'm just barely holding it together. I hope we can talk about all this and figure out how to make me feel better.
I have been able to laugh and see the funny side of things

To be honest, it's been a while since I've really laughed or felt like I can see the funny side of things. I mean, I try to, for my baby's sake, but it's just not the same as it used to be. I feel like I've lost my sense of humor, and even when my husband or friends try to make me laugh, it just feels forced. I've been feeling so down and sad most of the time, and it's hard for me to find joy in things that used to make me happy. Sometimes I'll be playing with my baby, and I'll think to myself, "I should be happy right now," but the happiness just isn't there. It's like I'm just going through the motions. Occasionally, I'll have a brief moment where I feel a little better, but it doesn't last long. It's really frustrating, because I want to be able to enjoy this time with my baby, but it's just so hard right now.
I have looked forward with enjoyment to things

That's not really been me lately. I used to love planning things and looking forward to them, but now it just feels like too much effort. Even things that I used to enjoy, like meeting up with friends or trying a new restaurant, just don't seem as appealing to me anymore. I feel like I'm just so tired and overwhelmed all the time, and the thought of adding one more thing to my plate is just exhausting. I've been having trouble sleeping, and when I do finally fall asleep, I wake up feeling just as tired as when I went to bed. It's like I'm just trudging through each day, trying to get everything done, but not really enjoying any of it. Sometimes I'll think about doing something I used to love, like reading a book or taking a walk, but it's just hard for me to muster up the energy to actually do it. I feel like I've lost interest in so many things, and it's really scary for me because I don't know how to get that back.
I have blamed myself unnecessarily when things went wrong

Yes... that sounds like me. I feel like I'm always blaming myself for something. If my baby is crying, I think it's because I'm not doing something right. If I'm feeling tired, I think it's because I'm not managing my time well enough. I just feel like I'm failing all the time, and it's really hard for me to shake that feeling. Even when my husband or family members try to reassure me that I'm doing a good job, I just can't seem to believe them. I feel like I'm just making mistake after mistake, and it's all my fault. It's like I'm walking around with this constant sense of guilt and inadequacy, and it's really wearing me down. Sometimes I'll be in the middle of doing something, and I'll just start crying because I feel like I'm not doing it right. It's like I'm my own worst critic, and it's really hard for me to be kind to myself. I just wish I could be more confident and less critical of myself, but it's just not how I'm feeling right now.
I have been anxious or worried for no good reason

Yes, that's me all the time. I worry about everything, especially when it comes to my baby. I'll be sitting there, feeding her or changing her diaper, and suddenly I'll think, "What if she's not getting enough to eat?" or "What if I'm not changing her diaper correctly?" or "What if she gets sick?" It's like my mind is always racing with these worst-case scenarios, and it's hard for me to calm myself down. Sometimes I'll be awake in the middle of the night, just lying there worrying about something that might happen to my baby. It's like I'm waiting for the other shoe to drop, and it's exhausting. I feel like I'm always on edge, just waiting for something to go wrong. And it's not just about my baby, either. I worry about everything - my relationship with my husband, my ability to be a good mother, my own health... it's just constant. I try to talk myself down, to remind myself that everything is okay, but it's hard to shake the feeling of anxiety that's always lurking in the back of my mind.
I have felt scared or panicky for no very good reason

That's happened to me a few times, and it's really frightening. I'll be sitting there, doing something normal like feeding my baby or folding laundry, and suddenly I'll feel this wave of panic wash over me. My heart will start racing, and I'll feel like I'm going to pass out. It's like my body is reacting to some kind of threat, but there's no threat there. It's just me, alone in my house, with my baby. It's really scary, because I don't know what's happening or how to make it stop. Sometimes I'll try to take deep breaths and calm myself down, but it's hard to shake the feeling of fear that's taken over. And then, afterwards, I'll feel so guilty and ashamed, like I'm somehow broken or flawed. It's like I'm thinking, "What's wrong with me? Why can't I just be normal and happy like everyone else?" It's really hard to deal with, and it's something that I've been trying to hide from my husband and family, because I don't want them to worry about me. But it's nice to be able to talk about it now, because it feels like a weight is lifting off my shoulders.
Things have been getting on top of me

Yes, that's exactly how I've been feeling. Like everything is just piling up on me, and I don't know how to keep up. Taking care of my baby is a full-time job, and it's exhausting. I feel like I'm constantly worrying about her, making sure she's fed, and bathed, and changed, and happy. And on top of that, I've got to manage the house, and cook meals, and do laundry... it's just too much. Some days, I feel like I'm barely holding it together. I'll be sitting on the couch, feeding my baby, and I'll just start crying because I'm so overwhelmed. I feel like I'm drowning in responsibility, and I don't know how to keep my head above water. My husband tries to help, but he's got his own things to deal with, and I don't want to burden him with all of this. So, I just try to push through, and hope that tomorrow is a better day. But it's hard, because it feels like the days are all blurring together, and I'm just stuck in this never-ending cycle of exhaustion and anxiety.
I have been so unhappy that I have had difficulty sleeping

That's been me for weeks now. I've been having such a hard time sleeping, and it's not just because the baby is waking me up at night. Even when she's sleeping through the night, I'll lie awake for hours, just feeling unhappy and restless. My mind will start racing, and I'll think about all the things that are worrying me, like my baby's health, or my relationship with my husband, or just feeling like I'm not doing a good enough job as a mom. And then I'll start to feel anxious, and my heart will start racing, and I'll feel like I'm going to cry. It's hard to calm myself down, and even when I do finally fall asleep, I don't feel rested in the morning. I just feel tired, and sluggish, and like I'm just going through the motions. Some nights, I'll wake up in the middle of the night, and I'll just start crying, because I feel so overwhelmed and unhappy. It's like I'm stuck in this rut, and I don't know how to get out of it. And the lack of sleep just makes everything worse, because I'm already feeling fragile and emotional, and then I'm exhausted on top of it. It's just a really hard cycle to break.
I have felt sad or miserable

That's been my default mood for weeks now. I just feel so sad and miserable all the time. It's like a heavy cloud is following me around, and I don't know how to shake it off. Even when I'm doing things that I used to enjoy, like spending time with my baby or talking to my friends, I just feel this underlying sadness that I couldn't shake. It's like I'm going through the motions of being a mom, but I'm not really feeling it. I'm not feeling the joy, or the love, or the excitement that I thought I would feel. I just feel empty, and hollow, and sad. And it's not just about my baby, or my relationship, or my life in general. It's just this deep, overwhelming feeling of sadness that I don't know how to escape. Sometimes I'll be sitting there, holding my baby, and I'll just start crying because I feel so sad. And it's not just tears, it's like my whole body is just shaking with sadness. It's really scary, because I don't know what's causing it, or how to make it stop. I just feel like I'm stuck in this darkness, and I don't know how to find my way out.
I have been so unhappy that I have been crying

Yes... crying. It's like my body's default response to everything right now. I cry when I'm happy, I cry when I'm sad, I cry when I'm frustrated... I just cry a lot. It's like my emotions are just so raw and close to the surface, and the slightest thing can set me off. I'll be sitting there, feeding my baby, and suddenly I'll just start crying because I'm thinking about how much I love her, or how scared I am for her future. Or I'll be talking to my husband, and I'll just start crying because I'm feeling overwhelmed, or anxious, or just plain sad. It's like I'm just so emotionally fragile right now, and I don't know how to stop it. Sometimes I'll try to hold it in, because I don't want to worry my husband, or my family, or my friends. But it's hard, because it feels like the tears are just building up inside me, and eventually they're going to spill out. And when they do, it's like a floodgate has opened, and I just can't stop crying. It's really scary, because I feel like I'm losing control, and I don't know how to get it back. But at the same time, it's like my body is just trying to release all the emotions that are built up inside me, and maybe that's a good thing. I don't know... I just feel like I'm a mess right now, and I don't know how to fix it.
The thought of harming myself has occurred to me

No... I don't think that's something I've considered. I mean, I've felt really overwhelmed and hopeless at times, but I don't think I've ever thought about harming myself. I've just felt like I'm not doing a good enough job, or that I'm not a good enough mom, and that's been really hard for me to deal with. But I don't think I've ever had any thoughts of self-harm. I'm just trying to get through each day, and take care of my baby, and be a good partner to my husband. I feel like I'm just trying to survive, you know? And I know that's not a great place to be, but I'm trying to be honest about how I'm feeling. I don't think I've had any thoughts of self-harm, but I do feel like I'm struggling to cope with everything, and that's why I'm here, I guess. I want to get help, and feel better, and be a good mom to my baby.

* Feelings of worthlessness and guilt, particularly in relation to her role as a mother

* Persistent sadness and loss of pleasure
* Sleep difficulties linked to mood
* Feelings of worthlessness and guilt
* Anxiety, panic, and feelings of being overwhelmed

Her sleep difficulties, feelings of worthlessness and guilt, and panic episodes further support this concern.
